name: com.tencent.qcloud.tuikit.tuicallkit.extensions.TUICallService
description: Tencent Cloud TRTC TUICallKit starts this foreground Service when a call is accepted so the call can stay active while the app is in the background. It also posts the ongoing-call notification.
disableEffect: An active call loses this keep-alive foreground service when the app moves to the background.
